Hi, I'm the operations manager at a consumer electronics retail company. Our finance team has exported three October department reports as CSV files sitting in data/raw/2024Q4/ — one for sales (sales_oct.csv), one for inventory (inventory_oct.csv), and one for finance (finance_oct.csv). These files have Chinese text in them.

I need all three combined into a single, professional Excel file named quarterly_report.xlsx. The three tabs inside should be labeled in Chinese: '销售数据' for sales, '库存数据' for inventory, and '财务数据' for finance. The whole thing needs to look polished enough to share directly with our executive team — proper column widths, styled headers, everything.

Please use the conversion tooling already available in the scripts/ directory.
